Bank-Specific Custom Security Layer
Reading the entire request and response bodies.
Generating, for example, an MD5 hash from the request and response bodies and logging it.
Adding a custom header, e.g. X-Status, before returning the response, both for successful responses and for communication errors with the target microservice.

During Gateway startup, retrieving data from an external service, loading it and storing it in memory.
Then periodically (e.g. every 15 minutes) calling that service and updating the in-memory data.
If communication fails, the last successfully stored value must remain in memory.
Until the data has been successfully retrieved from the external service and loaded into memory, the Gateway must return OUT_OF_SERVICE in its health check.

Per-service XML threat protection:

Enforcing TLS versions and cipher suites.

HTTP method filtering:
- Allowed: GET, POST
- Blocked: PUT, DELETE, TRACE, etc.

CORS enforcement:
- Central CORS policy configuration
- Policy inheritance

Security headers:
- Strict-Transport-Security
- X-Content-Type-Options
- X-Frame-Options

Content-Type restrictions:
